question: ______ is caused by severe protein deficiency.
solution:
The correct answer is ​__**Kwashiorkor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kwashiorkor** is caused by** severe protein deficiency.**
 
• **About Proteins:**
 
 
• Proteins are one of the** building blocks of body tissue.**
 
• Proteins are made up **of Carbon, Hydrogen, Oxygen, and Nitrogen.**
 
• Proteins help for the **growth and repair of the body.**
 
• Proteins are the nutrient** known as 'bodybuilders'.**
 
• **Amino acid **is the** basic unit of proteins.**
 
• **The Soyabean** contains** the highest percentage of protein.**
 
• The major source of proteins** is meat, milk, egg, fish, gram, etc.**
 
• **Marasmus** is also caused by severe protein deficiency.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rickets and Valk-Skin **are caused due to deficiency of** Vitamin D **
 
• **Iodine deficiency** is the most common **cause of goiter.**
 
• **Xerophthalmia** is a progressive** eye disease** caused by** vitamin A deficiency.**
